voices.note: anonymous redactorial voice: ואידך מאי היא, and the בצרי להו objection
the mishna of Shabbat 13b.2 (ושמונה עשר דבר גזרו בו ביום), whose count is attacked at 16b.9
reports the school of Rav at 16b.8

props.gloss_en: and eighteen things they decreed on that day
the stam: the other of the eighteen decrees is that of vessels placed under the drainpipe
Beit Shammai: one who places vessels under the drainpipe to collect rainwater -- large or small vessels, even stone, earth or dung vessels -- [the water] disqualifies the mikveh
Beit Shammai: the same whether he placed them or forgot them there
Beit Hillel declare [the mikveh] pure where he forgot [the vessels]
R' Meir: they were counted, and Beit Shammai outnumbered Beit Hillel
and Beit Shammai concede that one who forgets [vessels] in the courtyard -- it is pure
R' Yosei: the dispute still stands in its place
the school of Rav: all agree that if he placed them when the clouds were gathering, they are impure
the school of Rav: [if he placed them] when the clouds were scattering, all say they are pure
the school of Rav: they disputed only where he placed them while the clouds gathered, and they scattered, and gathered again
one master holds his intention was voided
and the other master holds his intention was not voided
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: [the decree that] the daughters of Kutim are menstruants from their cradle -- that too they decreed on that day

supports.gloss_en: דתנן: המניח כלים תחת הצינור ... אמר רבי מאיר: נמנו ורבו בית שמאי על בית הלל -- the counted vote in Beit Shammai's favour is the decree

objections.gloss_en: ולרבי יוסי דאמר מחלוקת עדיין במקומה עומדת, בצרי להו! -- on R' Yosei's view the drainpipe dispute was never decided, so it is not one of that day's decrees and the eighteen fall short (the objection holds on R' Yosei's view only)
